notes.title: Pre-Registration Now Open for !
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639227/c9ba9d68e7681e5bdbd1143888db411bf5d193d8.png[/img]

Tristan’s journey to restore the twisted time and space through the Book of Stars begins now!

Greetings, Star Guardians.
This is [b]<The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin>[/b].

Mark your calendars — pre-registration for <The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin> begins on Sunday, June 1st, across all platforms: console, PC, and mobile!

Visit the official brand site below to pre-register and explore a variety of content, including character introductions, worldbuilding details, and the release roadmap.

You can also [b]add <The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin> to your wishlist on the Steam Store[/b] to receive the latest launch updates as soon as they’re available. We sincerely appreciate your interest and support!

For more information, please refer to the details below.

[h3]◈ <The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin> Pre-Registration Details ◈[/h3]

[b]🔹 Pre-Registration Period[/b]
- June 1, 2025 (Sun) 20:05 (PDT) - Until the official launch

[b]🔹 Official <The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin> Brand Site[/b]
[url=https://ntiny.link/discord_GB]▶ Go to the Official <The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin> Brand Site[/url]

[b]🔸 Notes[/b]
- The pre-registration period is subject to change based on internal circumstances. Any changes will be announced through this notice.

We look forward to your interest and participation, Star Guardians!

Thank you.
